functions.purpose: Builds a UI view-object describing a player targeted for a battle-team/clan invite. Extracts a target id from the tagged-arg blob (arg+8 when type tag (arg+4)&0x8f is 3 or 4), resolves the player through the social manager (DAT_1202e818->[0xd0]->[0x90] vtbl+0x7c = FindPlayerById), rejects it if vtbl+0xa8 returns nonzero (invalid/self), and reads the local party/team via vtbl+0xb4. Emits playerName (obj->GetName), playerFaction (vtbl+0x44), playerLevel (CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount), selfID (*(team+4)).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (presentation VO; reads already-synced player/party state)
functions.notes: Field setters used throughout chunk: FUN_104d1550=set int, FUN_104d1670=set ASCII str, FUN_104d1700=set wide str, FUN_104d1440=set 64-bit, FUN_104d15e0=set bool, FUN_104d14d0=clear/default, FUN_104d12b0=attach child obj/array, FUN_104d7c10=pop/commit. FUN_11a98de0=create VO instance, FUN_11a98a70=create array.

functions.purpose: Iterates battle-team member 'boxes' and builds a member-info VO for the box whose player faction matches a target id (arg[0xe]). Box list at localTeam(+0xb4)->list; count = (list[0x88]-list[0x84])>>3. Per box: resolves player (FUN_1092b9b0), if player->vtbl_0x44()==targetId emits fields.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (VO builder over synced battle-team roster)
formulas: match when player->vtbl_0x44() == targetId (targetId = arg[0xe] if (arg[0xd]&0x8f)==3||4 else 0xDEADBEAF)
functions.notes: Emits selectedBoxID=box[1], playerNetID=box[0], playerName, playerFaction=0, playerLevel=GetHuntRankOrCount, selfID=*(EBX+4), boxIndex, boxName (from FUN_108f2ca0(box[1])->+0x14).

functions.notes: Confirms local-player struct offset 0x2adc holds the clan/battle-team component pointer.

functions.purpose: Handles an incoming clan invite (stores inviter ids at model+0x28/+0x2c). Reads config flag 'g_refuseClanRequest' (config mgr [0x2c]->vtbl_0x54('g_refuseClanRequest')->vtbl_0x08 = GetInt). If flag==0: pops a confirm dialog 'BattleTeam.MsgBoxClanInviteOk'/'BattleTeam.MsgBoxClanInviteCancel' (dialog id 0x1ff1) with localized message-parm indices 0x2a and 6. If flag!=0 (auto-refuse enabled): silently rejects via FUN_11c65590(guild, inviteId1, inviteId2, 0).
functions.serverRelevance: validation/client (client decides prompt vs auto-reject; the actual accept/reject is sent to server)
formulas: dialog id = 0x1ff1; CMessageParmDescInfo record indices 0x2a and 6 (localized text)
functions.notes: 'g_refuseClanRequest' is a client preference; server still authoritative on membership. inviteId1/inviteId2 stored at model +0x28,+0x2c.

functions.notes: Command names enumerate the league client->server surface: StartGameLeagueReq, StartGameLeaguePairReq, GetGuildPreMaryByPage (qualifier bracket), xGetRoomBySignId, SendGuildMatchQualifierResultList, sendGuildMatchPairList.

functions.purpose: Builds the guild qualifier ('GuildPremary') ranking list VO, one entry per qualifying guild. Reads guild-match data at guildMgr(+0x2abc), calls its vtbl_0x0c (refresh) and FUN_11c65620(mgr,0xd) then FUN_10942d70 to fetch the entry vector (piVar1+10). Iterates entries with stride 0x58 (88 bytes; count=(end-begin)/0x58). Per entry: strName (FUN_1149e590), bestScore (FUN_1149e540), a second score field (FUN_1149e550, name DAT_11dca154), strGuildName (FUN_1149e580), isSelf=1 when FUN_1149e820 matches local guild. Emits array 'GuildPremaryArray' of class 'GUILDPREMARY_CLASS_NAME'.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (VO over server-supplied qualifier ranking)
formulas: entry stride = 0x58 bytes (0x16 dwords); count = (vec_end - vec_begin)/0x58
bestScore = FUN_1149e540(entry); secondScore = FUN_1149e550(entry); isSelf = FUN_1149e820(guildId)
functions.notes: guild-match/qualifier component offset on local player = +0x2abc. Field 'bestScore' is the guild's best qualifier score.

functions.purpose: Builds the guild-match bracket/pairing VO ('GuildMathTeamArray' of class 'GUILDMathTeam_CLASS_NAME'). Reads match data (guildMgr+0x2abc). Emits MatchStateNow = *(match+0x120), MathState = *(match+0x11c). Two code paths keyed on MatchStateNow: when state<5 it walks bracket rounds 4..1 (round counter starts at 4, decrements while >0) producing per-round pairings; when state in [5,7) it walks the final pairing list directly. Pairing entries have stride 0x10. Per pairing emits m_SignID1, m_SignID2, teamName1, teamName2, teamWin1/teamWin2, isPlaying.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (VO over server bracket state; scoring/pairing authoritative server-side)
formulas: state<5 -> iterate bracket rounds 4 down to 1; state in [5,7) -> final list path
functions.notes: m_SignID1/m_SignID2 are the two teams' sign ids; winnerSignID compared field is the round result. Bracket depth 4 rounds implied by the 4..1 loop.

functions.purpose: League invite/enter-room respond handler. Resolves local player league component (player->vtbl_0x3a4). Compares the room/team leader id (team->vtbl_0x88()->vtbl_0x0c) against my id (player[1]). If I am the leader: enter directly (FUN_107cb5c0 -> mgr(+0x2abc)->vtbl_0x0c, then FUN_111764b0(1,1)). Otherwise: pop a confirm dialog (id 0x1ff6, 'LeagueRespondOkHandler'/'LeagueRespondCancelHandler') showing the leader's name (FUN_1024e9b0(name,6)).
functions.serverRelevance: validation/client (client gates on leadership; enter/respond sent to server)
functions.notes: Leader auto-enters; non-leaders are prompted. Uses league component offset player->vtbl_0x3a4.

functions.purpose: Standard InfoManager accessor for the CGuildMatchInfo config table. Gets/creates the singleton manager (CGuildMatchInfo::GetInfoManager or CInfoManager::FindByName('CGuildMatchInfo')), then does the usual 2D bucketed lookup to return the record for a given id.
functions.serverRelevance: config data (static table; both client and server read the same guild-match config)
formulas: idx = id - mgr[0xc]; valid if 0<=idx<mgr[9]; record = mgr[8][idx/mgr[10]][idx%mgr[10]]
mgr[8]=bucket array, mgr[9]=count, mgr[0xa]=stride/bucketSize, mgr[0xc]=id base
functions.notes: Stock InfoManager pattern (same shape as FUN_10968af0 and the CMessageParmDescInfo lookups in 1093faf0).

functions.purpose: Builds a mail-with-attachments reader VO ('GIFT_BOX_READER_DATA_CLASSNAME' + nested 'MAIL_EXTRACT_ITEM_DATA_CLASSNAME' item list). Reads the mailbox at localPlayer(+0x2ac4), scans mail records (via FUN_114fd740 list piStack_5c..piStack_58) to find the mail whose key matches (*(mail)==*(mailbox+0x78) && mail[1]==*(mailbox+0x7c)). Builds item sub-array from mail attachment entries (mail[0x29]..mail[0x2a], stride 0x20).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (VO over server-synced mail; attachment claim is a separate server request)
formulas: mail fields: gold(nGiftID area DAT_11dc0944)=mail[0x23], goldIndex=mail[0x24], source=(char)mail[2], strSender=mail[0xb], strTitle=mail[0x17], strContent=mail[0x1d]
costs: attachment amounts read as u16 per-item _count; gold amount at mail[0x23], goldIndex at mail[0x24]
functions.notes: mailbox component offset localPlayer+0x2ac4. Mail record: sender +0x2c(0xb dwords), title +0x5c(0x17), content +0x74(0x1d), attachments vector at +0xa4/+0xa8 (0x29/0x2a).

functions.purpose: Builds a party/team member info VO. functions.serverRelevance: client-only (VO over synced team roster)
formulas: subTeamID = FUN_112e5600(netId) + FUN_112e5540(netId)*4   (default -1 if no team)
memberLevel = CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount; memberHRLevel = FUN_1025b060(); memberTotalHP = FUN_1134b990(); memberCurrentHP = FUN_1025b060()
functions.notes: Emits weaponType, memberLevel, memberHRLevel, memberName, memberTotalHP, memberCurrentHP, memberState=0, memberNetID=param_2[1], Watched=0, membterFaction, serverID=param_2[0xb5e], subTeamID. serverID offset 0xb5e dwords is notable.

functions.purpose: Large builder for the league/PVP-battle screen. Reads league component (localPlayer+0x2b9c). Emits header fields strTitleName, maxPvpBattleCount (component vtbl_0x20), curPvpBattleCount (vtbl_0x28), nEntrustVipCnt (FUN_11548ea0 when data[0xabe]!=0). Iterates league entries (vector stride 0x14): iLeagueID, iCountLeague = (levelsEnd-levelsBegin)>>2, plus a per-level sub-array (levelGroupID, levelID, levelName) and matching leagueTasksArr. Then a notices loop (stride 0x18): noticeLeagueID, noticeStartLeagueTime, noticeEndLeagueTime, noticePvpBattleRound, noticeLeagueName. Also builds pvpBattleListArr and pvpBattleNoticeArr; CLeagueInfo::CollectLeagueScheduleEntries fills the notice list.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (VO over server league schedule/task state)
formulas: league entry stride = 0x14 (20) bytes; iCountLeague = (levelVecEnd - levelVecBegin) >> 2
time offset constant 0x261d0 (=155600) added to a base time (iStack_164)
costs: maxPvpBattleCount / curPvpBattleCount = per-player league battle attempt cap and usage; nEntrustVipCnt = VIP entrust count
functions.notes: league component offset localPlayer+0x2b9c. Heavy decompiler stack aliasing lowers confidence on some offsets; field names and array structure are reliable.

Per entry emits strTXT, strChatBg, nPlayerId, bUpdateIcon=1, nWidth=-1, nHeight=-1. Target array chosen by DAT_1202e818[0x10]->vtbl_0x608 (0 -> array01, 1 -> array02). Writes count to output+0x28.

functions.purpose: Builds the faction/PVP battle result score VO. Reads a score struct (unaff_EBX) and the level context (CMHLevelSystem::GetCurrentContext). Emits redBound/blueBound, playerDamage, damagePercentage, useTime, playerScore, accumulateScore, damageScore, withOutInjuryScore, isRedFaction, speedScore, charLevel, charName, winScore. Guarded on local player + battle context + FUN_114584c0(myId) valid.
functions.serverRelevance: validation/client (client re-derives display scores from the same formula the server uses; server remains authoritative on stored scores)
formulas: score struct offsets: playerScore=+0x28, speedScore(base)=+0x2c, damageScore=+0x30, withOutInjuryScore=+0x34, redBound=+0x20, blueBound=+0x24
speedScore: if redBound==blueBound OR (winningSideFlag != isRedFaction): speedScore = *(EBX+0x2c); else speedScore = *(EBX+0x2c) - (ctx[0xc8]*ctx[0xd4])/100
winningSideFlag = (blueBound <= redBound)  [i.e. red is winning side]
costs: winScore bonus = (ctx[0xc8] * ctx[0xd4]) / 100 (a percentage of a base value); speedScore deducts this bonus from raw score when on winning side
functions.notes: This is the one function in the chunk with real scoring arithmetic: the /100 win-bonus and the winning-side speedScore adjustment should be replicated server-side for authoritative scoring. ctx[0xc8]=base value, ctx[0xd4]=percent factor.

functions.purpose: Builds the guild activity/task overview VO ('GUILDER_INFO_DATA_NAME' + nested 'GUILDER_ACTIVITY_TASK_DATA_NAME'). Reads guild data (guildMgr+0x2abc) and activity component (+0x2ab0). Emits guild-week score, player/guild activity totals and caps, then five task VOs (taskA=1-star, taskB=2-star, taskC=3-star, taskD=4-star, taskS=special id 99999). Each task VO: taskId, nStar, strNameTask, nCountTask, nTotalCountTask, nScoreTask, nStatus.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO, but reveals authoritative guild-activity/task fields the server owns (scores, activity caps, completion status)
formulas: nGuildScoreInWeek = guildData[0x70]; nPlayerScoreTotal = guildData->vtbl_0x18(); nPlayerActivityInToday = guildData->vtbl_0x34()
task record (FUN_117d8be0) offsets per star tier A/B/C/D: nTotalCountTask = record[+0x40,+0x44,+0x48,+0x4c]; nScoreTask = record[+0x50,+0x54,+0x58,+0x5c]
nStar values: taskA=1, taskB=2, taskC=3, taskD=4, taskS=0 (id 99999)
nStatus: if task-done-flag ptr != 0 -> 1 (completed); else claimable-check guild->vtbl_0x60() ? 4 (claimable) : -1 (locked/0xffffffff)
costs: nScoreTask = contribution/activity points awarded per task tier (record offsets +0x50..+0x5c)
activity caps: nPlayerActivityMax, nGuildActivityMax (daily activity ceilings)
taskS gated by counter id 0x494 (guild-comp vtbl_0x30 query, threshold >=1)
functions.notes: Status enum {completed=1, claimable=4, locked=-1, in-progress=0} is reusable server-side. guild data offset +0x2abc, activity component +0x2ab0. Decompiler stack aliasing is heavy; treat offsets as best-effort.

functions.purpose: Builds a single guild-task detail VO ('GUILD_TASK_INFO_DATA_NAME'). Guarded on argCount==2. Reads guild task config record (FUN_104d8d20(taskId)) and the player's guild component (guildMgr+0x2abc region, ptrs at +0xaaf/+0xaac). Emits strName, taskId, reward (nMoneyType/nMoneyCount), nTaskAddition, strTarget (task step), UI button flags, and nTaskState.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO, but exposes guild-task reward + state model that server must own
formulas: taskId = arg[0x20] when (arg+0x1c)&0x8f in {3,4} else 0xDEADBEAF sentinel; special S-task id = 99999
reward split: CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount(reward[1], &moneyFloat, &expInt, 0); if moneyFloat>0 && reward[0xc]>0 -> nMoneyType=0,nMoneyCount; if expInt>0 && reward[8]>0 -> nMoneyType=0,nMoneyCount
task step vector stride = 0xec (236) bytes; strTarget from step, fields step[+0x18], step[+0x1c] (DAT_11de486c/11de4830)
all button flags bShowAccept/bEnableAccept/bShowGiveUp/bEnableGiveUp/bShowFinish/bEnableFinish emitted (0 in this path)
costs: nMoneyType/nMoneyCount = task reward currency & amount; nTaskAddition = bonus/addition value
functions.notes: counter id 0x494 recurs (guild task-state query, same as taskS in 109e0950). Reward record accessed via FUN_10804940 with type 0x18. Multiple 'Removing unreachable block' warnings indicate optimized-away branches; button-enable logic not fully recoverable here.
